agent_explanation: Shrunk single-body free-fall with elastic ceiling bounce (e=1) and large dt=0.0287 shows monotonic energy gain without controller work: gravity integration with semi-implicit Euler and ~40 substeps per step adds ~1J after bounce then ~58J and ~61J on next two free-fall steps. Energy rises from E0 971.965 to 1092.714 at step 3, exceeding the 10%+5J allowance (1074.16). Reducing dt to 0.005 eliminates drift, and zero-gravity also eliminates it, confirming numerical energy creation by the integrator under large dt + gravity, especially after restitution-handling, not external work.
